name: harborrank
description: SEO research on live Google data: keywords, SERPs, local Maps grids, competitors, rank tracking, site audits, AI visibility, and your own Search Console and Google Analytics, with eighteen guided SEO workflows.

interface.longDescription:
HarborRank brings live Google search data and your own Search Console and Google Analytics into the conversation, so you can do SEO by asking.

What you can do:
- Keyword research: search volume, keyword difficulty, CPC, intent and monthly trends, plus ideas from seed topics or a domain.
- Live Google results: organic SERPs with People Also Ask, related searches and AI Overview text, and local Maps packs for any location.
- Competitor research: a site's ranking keywords, estimated organic traffic, top pages, backlink overview, and the backlink strength of up to 1,000 domains at once.
- Local rank grid: where a business shows in Google Maps from a grid of points across town, saved as a heatmap.
- Rank tracking: tracked keyword positions and their history, with competitor domains compared in the same checks.
- Site audits: crawl a site for broken pages, redirects, missing or duplicate titles, noindex, canonicals and thin content, compare the latest audit with the previous one, and read real-user Core Web Vitals.
- AI visibility: how often AI answers mention a brand, its share of voice against competitors, and what the major AI assistants answer to the same question.
- Search Console (read-only): clicks, impressions, CTR and position by query, page, country and date, URL inspection, and submitted sitemaps.
- Google Analytics (read-only): conversions and revenue per landing page joined with Search Console, and visits referred by AI assistants.
- Projects: saved keyword lists, keyword clusters mapped to their target pages, and shareable read-only reports.
- Local lead research for agencies: find local businesses on Google Maps and build a one-page SEO teardown for each.

Eighteen guided workflows come with the plugin, from an SEO coach for beginners and project setup to keyword research and clustering, competitor analysis, SEO audits and traffic-drop diagnosis, local SEO, AI search visibility, link prospecting, client reports and local lead teardowns.

Who it's for: small business owners, marketers, content writers and SEO freelancers or agencies who want real search data without learning an enterprise SEO suite.

Limitations: you need a HarborRank account (sign in when you connect). Search Console and Google Analytics data appear only after you connect those properties in HarborRank, and access is read-only. Some features, such as full backlink profiles, local grid scans and lead teardowns, are not available on every HarborRank plan. Search data reflects Google at the time of the request.

defaultPrompt: Find low-competition keywords for a plumber in Boston.
Why does my competitor outrank me on Google? Compare my site with theirs.
Audit my website for technical SEO problems and rank the fixes.

positive.prompt: What's the search volume and keyword difficulty for 'emergency plumber boston' and 'water heater repair boston'?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns US search volume, keyword difficulty, CPC and intent for both keywords in a table, with a short note on which is easier to rank for.

positive.description: Live Google results for a query
positive.prompt: Show me the top 10 Google results for 'best running shoes for flat feet'.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the current top organic results with position, title, domain and URL, and summarizes the content types that rank.

positive.prompt: Give me an SEO overview of rei.com: estimated organic traffic and its top ranking keywords.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports estimated organic traffic and keyword counts for rei.com and lists top ranking keywords with position and volume.

positive.description: Local Maps pack for a service
positive.prompt: Who shows up in the Google Maps results for 'dentist' in Salem, Massachusetts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the businesses in the local pack with rank, name, rating, review count and website where available.

positive.description: Account and projects for the signed-in user
positive.prompt: Which HarborRank projects do I have, and what keywords are saved in the first one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's projects and the saved keywords of the first project; if none are saved, says so without inventing any.

negative.description: Writing content is outside the plugin's tools
negative.prompt: Write me a 1,500-word blog post about summer recipes.

negative.description: Requests to change a live website
negative.prompt: Log into my WordPress site and change the homepage title tag.
What's the weather in Boston tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds tools for local rank grids (run_local_grid, get_local_grid), rank history and competitor tracking (get_rank_history, add_rank_tracker_competitors), audit comparison (compare_site_audits), real-user Core Web Vitals (get_core_web_vitals), backlink strength for many domains (get_domain_ranks), keyword cluster target pages (set_cluster_target_page), Search Console sitemaps (get_search_console_sitemaps) and AI visibility (get_ai_brand_visibility, ask_ai_models, get_ai_brand_tracking). get_serp_results now returns People Also Ask, related searches and AI Overview text. Rank checks re-read a keyword before recording a drop and report "not checked" separately from "not found". The skills bundle grows from nine to eighteen guided workflows.
